g.text: DNS returns a private address. HTTPS stays on the tailnet.
Cilium owns the hubble-ui ClusterIP Service.
This path is separate from browser traffic.
Helm installs ingress-nginx with its chart Service disabled.
Ingress/hubble-ui defines the route and TLS Secret.
The runbook creates Service/hubble-ui-tailscale; the operator advertises its VIP.
Cloudflare hosts DNS only. It does not proxy application traffic.
NGINX sees the proxy Pod IP, not the original tailnet client IP.
